title: Stored Procedure
description: Create a stored procedure 'transfer_product_stock(from_product_id INT, to_product_id INT, qty INT)' that transfers stock between products. It should decrement quantity from the source and increment on the destination, and raise an exception if insufficient stock.
hints: Use CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE (not FUNCTION)
Check stock with IF (SELECT quantity FROM products WHERE product_id = from_id) < qty THEN RAISE
Use UPDATE for both products inside a single transaction
